Karthik / Monica —

I reviewed the ask from Acme and sketched a minimal infra test plan:
- Small-scale functional tests (KV cache, auth, KMS integration) ~ 2k credits
- Throughput tests (100k tokens across 3 model configs) ~ 6k credits
- End-to-end validation + bug iterations ~ 2k credits

Total estimate ~10k credits over ~45 days if we keep to a single model family. If they want multi-region tests or longer retention we should budget more. Ill prepare a 1-page runbook for their infra team and can triage any support access questions.

Also: their filled questionnaire referenced a request for IP allowlist and a short-term support window during the first integration run. Those are standard; we should be able to grant a temporary support SSH tunnel via the private control plane team if legal signs off.

I recommend approving 10k promotional credits for 60 days, marked for Private POC usage only, and require a short security acknowledgment form from Acme to proceed.

—Marissa
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
